name: Stopping the Cycle
summary: At the Dragonmaw Gates, warlocks are trying to enslave a red dragonspawn. Howin Kindfeather returns from a test flight with troubling news, and the Wildhammer will not let it happen again.

sections.title: At the Gates
sections.body: Howin Kindfeather asks you to face the subdued dragonspawn at the Dragonmaw Gates. First, kill the warlocks holding it down. That should free it. Then put the dragonspawn out of its misery. Howin expects you to bring friends, for the Wildhammer will not let the Dragonmaw stand in their way.

faq.answer: Howin Kindfeather asks you to stop the Dragonmaw from enslaving a red dragonspawn.
A group of Dragonmaw warlocks is holding down a red dragonspawn and trying to enslave it.
The subdued dragonspawn is at the Dragonmaw Gates.

faq.q: What does Howin ask me to do?
faq.answer: Howin asks you to kill the warlocks holding the dragonspawn down, then put it out of its misery.

faq.q: Why does Howin say the Wildhammer cannot allow this?
faq.answer: Howin says the Dragonmaw are enslaving a red dragonspawn, and insists the Wildhammer will not let them stand in their way.
